title: Permaculture Design Certificate | 2026 Cohort #3
body:
If you’re looking for a robust overview of permaculture & regenerative design, this course is perfect for you!

2026 Cohort #3 PDC Course Runs October 5- December 23

Discover practical ways to understand and apply nature’s wisdom in your daily life. By combining scientific observation with time-tested traditions of regenerative living, this course reveals powerful new possibilities for creating healthier lives, thriving landscapes, and meaningful livelihoods.

Permaculture principles offer a practical framework for designing systems that work in harmony with nature. Through these methods, you’ll build the skills and confidence to become a more capable designer in everyday life—whether you’re planning a garden, organizing a project, or shaping a long-term vision for your home or community.

Permaculture provides accessible, affordable, and achievable solutions that can be applied anywhere—from homes and gardens to farms, businesses, and community initiatives. Learn how to meet more of your own needs while cultivating resilience, productivity, and abundance in a rapidly changing world.

Permaculture is a comprehensive design science for building resilient landscapes, livelihoods, and communities rooted in the principles of living systems. This course brings that science to life through the lens of the Soil Food Web.

Developed in cooperation with the Permaculture Association (UK), this certificate covers 72 hours of instruction across 12 weeks of self-paced content, weekly live sessions, hands-on design projects, and a global peer community you’ll carry with you long after graduation.

title: Community Event | Celebrating Our First Year as a Foundation!
body:
On October 16th, we will celebrate the one-year anniversary of the Soil Food Web Foundation. 🌱

As we pursue new ways to impact the globes soils, we continually look back to our roots.

Dr. Elaine Ingham spent more than four decades proving something the agricultural establishment did not want to accept: that the biology that naturally lives and thrives in healthy soil is more powerful, more precise, and more effective than any chemical program ever devised by humans. She built the science and taught it without compromise. She gave the world a way to understand what living soil actually is, what we lose when we destroy it, and most importantly, how to restore it mindfully with biological amendments that can be made locally, and relatively easily and inexpensively.

The Soil Food Web Foundation exists to carry that forward. And in one year, what we have seen from this community has made us genuinely, deeply grateful.

Farmers in India building vermicompost that transforms their land. Practitioners in Kenya laying the groundwork for soil restoration at scale. Students in Cyprus, in Brazil, in South Africa taking what they learned into fields and communities that needed it. Researchers, mentors, partners, and everyday people who heard the science for the first time and could not unhear it. 🌍

None of this is our accomplishment alone, the restoration of the world’s soils belongs to every person who chose to learn, to implement, to share, and to keep going even when the conventional world pushed back.

On October 16th we will gather to celebrate with voices from across the globe in a special open community session. We want to hear from you!

What has this work meant to you?

What has changed in your soil, your farm, your community?

Come be part of this.

title: Compost Intensive Course | 2027 Cohort #1
body:
The Time Is Now… And Here’s Why

When made correctly, compost becomes a living biological resource that supports soil health and can improve plant resilience to pests and environmental stressors, increase yields and nutrient content, and enhance human health, all while supporting regenerative growing systems that transform and utilize organic waste products.

Mastering the art of BioComplete™ Compost production takes dedication, practice, and, often, the guidance of a trained professional. This composting process is the cornerstone of the Soil Food Web Approach, which is being used around the world to regenerate degraded soils quickly and effectively

The Soil Food Web School’s Compost Intensive Course aims to take anyone, regardless of educational background, skill level, or experience, and help them produce their own BioComplete™ Compost within 10 weeks.

About the Course

The Compost Intensive Course is a hands-on, 10-week online training designed to guide you through the process from beginning to end alongside a global cohort of peers.

There are NO prerequisites!

And it counts toward your consultant pathway*

Why It’s Worth Your Time

More than 80% of the people who took our pilot version of this course walked away with successful thermophilic piles that achieved BioComplete™ biological potency.

We have designed this for maximum learning, with minimum time commitment, while optimizing for long-term impact.

title: Accelerator Workshop | Costa Rica
body:
The January 2027 Accelerator Workshop takes place at Armonía Orgánica, which has outdoor workspaces (both covered and uncovered) and indoor classrooms where we will practice microscopy. 

Armonía’s mission is to serve as an example of organic product management, demonstrating ecological responsibility and supplying locally grown food.

To reserve your seat, complete this interest form and select Costa Rica in the locations section: https://school.soilfoodweb.com/pages/workshop-interest

Check out Armonia’s Instagram and Facebook pages to learn more!

title: Accelerator Workshop | New Mexico USA
body:
A 10-day in-person Accelerator workshop located at Synergia Ranch Retreat Center

(https://synergiaranch.com/about-us/)

This experience is designed to accelerate student learning through BioComplete Compost Production and Liquid Amendments and help you master the art of inoculate grade biological soil amendments in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.

Attendees will work in small groups guided by a mentor, to build, monitor, and maintain compost piles, brew a variety of liquid amendments, and practice microscope analyses with guidance. Microscopy sessions will be provided based on level of experience for beginner and advanced practitioners.  

If you are interested in this event, submit this form and select the New Mexico Location: https://school.soilfoodweb.com/pages/workshop-interest
